मोटकः --कं [मुट्-ण्वुल्] A pill.
--कं
A couple of broken blades of Kuśa
grass given at a Śrāddha (
भुग्नकुशपत्रद्वयं).

मोटनं^1, मोटनकं Crushing, pressing,
grinding, breaking.
--नः Wind,
air.

मोट्टायितं Silent involuntary
expression of affection towards an
absent lover, as when a woman,
her mind being taken up by her
lover, scratches the ear &c. when he
is remembered or talked of; it is
thus defined by उज्ज्वलमणिः -
कांतस्मरणवार्तादौ हृदि तद्भ वभावतः ।
प्राकट्यमभिलाषस्य मोट्टायितमुदीर्यते; see S.
